description: The bar chart illustrates the annual number of hateful communication datasets categorized by whether they are “Targeted” (blue) or “Untargeted” (orange) from 2012 to 2022, as presented in the paper “The Unseen Targets of Hate — A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets.” The vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets,” ranges from 0 to 160 in increments of 20, while the horizontal axis represents the year, spanning 2012 to 2022. Each year is represented by a stacked bar, with the blue segment indicating targeted datasets and the orange segment indicating untargeted datasets. The chart shows a clear upward trend in total datasets over time, with minimal activity before 2016. In 2012–2015, only one or two datasets per year are recorded, mostly untargeted. From 2016 onward, both categories grow, with untargeted datasets consistently outnumbering targeted ones until 2021, when targeted datasets (approximately 67) surpass untargeted (approximately 93) in total count for that year. In 2022, the total drops significantly, with about 10 targeted and 27 untargeted datasets. The legend in the top-left corner clarifies the color coding, and the bars are not sorted by value but chronologically by year. No annotations or emphasis are applied to specific bars beyond the color-coded stacking.
